scope: fixed integer-pixel Canvas font shorthand and retained family data

implementation.grammar: Integer px size0..1024, ordered ASCII unescaped family identifiers/strings, five base generic families, native EOF closing of a final quoted string. Invalid accepted-grammar values do not change state; other grammar remains explicit.
implementation.metadata: Size, ordered family names, generic-vs-literal flag and original source are retained independently of getter serialization.
implementation.text: Native normalized px size, canonical base generic names, space-containing family quoting and comma-space family list. The getter string is not used as a font-identity substitute.
implementation.state: Canvas snapshot includes parsed font metadata and public getter text; save/restore/reset use the same stored drawing state.

remaining: General font shorthand and escaped/non-ASCII family grammar
